title: Support impersonation
summary: A caller or message pretends to be support and asks for access or payment.
scenario: The request uses urgency or authority to make you reveal information or approve an action.
warning_signs: Unexpected contact about a problem or refund
Pressure to act before checking independently
Requests for passwords, PINs, or one-time codes
safe_actions: Pause and end the unexpected interaction
Use support details from a known account or statement
recovery_guidance: Secure the affected account through a known route
Ask the provider what containment options are available
reporting_guidance: Keep the message and transaction details
Use a reporting destination only after its source is independently checked
prevention_tips: Save provider contact details from a trusted source
false_positive_notes: A genuine provider may contact you, but you can still verify without using the incoming channel.
